```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Entity Value'>">
  %ent;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns/base" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns/sub">
  <!-- Comment containing special characters <>&'" -->
  <sub:child id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA block with entity reference & internal; and tags <xml></xml>
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base-ent "Base entity text">
  <!ENTITY combined "&base-ent; plus more text">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ELEMENT meta (#PCDATA)>">
  %param;
]>
<?pi-target processing instruction data with "quotes" and 'single quotes'?>
<catalog xmlns="http://schemas.example.com/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Another comment block describing the items -->
  <item xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section with markup: <item>&combined;</item>
    ]]>
  </item>
  <meta>Metadata element defined via parameter entity</meta>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent-a "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY ent-b "&ent-a; Beta">
  <!ENTITY ent-c "&ent-b; Gamma">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc SYSTEM "file.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-log level="debug" target="stdout"?>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/ns/1.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <!-- Deep comment with multiple -- dashes inside -->
  <record xsi:schemaLocation="http://archive.org/ns/1.0 schema.xsd">
    <![CDATA[
      First CDATA: &ent-c;
    ]]>
  </record>
  <record>
    <![CDATA[
      Second CDATA block ensuring heavy CDATA usage.
    ]]>
  </record>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section*)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ENTITY reference 'EntityValueText'>">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY token "TokenString">
]>
<?xml-app-info name="fuzzing" version="2.0"?>
<document xmlns="http://xml.org/ns/document" xmlns:custom="http://xml.org/ns/custom">
  <!-- Comment before the CDATA section -->
  <custom:section id="sec-1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA containing entity &reference; and custom namespace elements.
    ]]>
  </custom:section>
  <section>
    &reference; and &token;
  </section>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (stock*)>
  <!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY stock-id "ID-9999">
  <!ENTITY full-stock "&stock-id; - Active">
  <!NOTATION text-plain SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY readme SYSTEM "README.txt" NDATA text-plain>
  <!ENTITY % ext-macro "<!ELEMENT description (#PCDATA)>">
  %ext-macro;
]>
<?xml-custom-pi action="init" param="value"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/ns" xmlns:v="http://inventory.org/ns/view">
  <!-- Comment detailing inventory constraints -->
  <v:stock id="&stock-id;">
    <![CDATA[
      Inventory item details: &full-stock; inside CDATA.
    ]]>
  </v:stock>
  <description>Description defined via external DTD parameter entity macro.</description>
</inventory>
```
